content:wysiwyg_basic:1:85.html:
One-Time Opportunities

Our one-time opportunities are perfect for those who want a quick and easy way to make a difference. These include activities like serving a meal any day of the year or ringing a bell during the holidays.

content:wysiwyg_basic:3:0.html:
Group Opportunities

We can accommodate your group’s desire to do something good together – whether family, friends,coworkers, civic or church groups. Group volunteer activities are typically project-based or part of a larger event.

content:wysiwyg_basic:5:86.html:
Ongoing Opportunities

Ongoing opportunities are designed for those who want to get involved on a regular basis. We’ll Know you by your first name, and you’ll get to know the people in our programs. These include activities like working with youth, using your professional skills or serving after a disaster strikes.

content:wysiwyg_basic:8:41.html:
Red Shield Youth Centers

There are five Red Shield Youth Centers throughout Green Country offering a variety of volunteer opportunities to serve area youth. We are looking for individuals or groups to help with tutoring, coaching or teaching a special talent, such as music, photography or art.

content:wysiwyg_basic:12:26.html:
Emergency Disaster Services

The Salvation Army Is often called upon to serve during times of disaster. Volunteers play a vital role in coming alongside us to care for those who have been displaced by fires, tornadoes and other natural disasters.

  • Canteen Driver
  • Food Service Specialist
  • Cleaning Canteen
  • Spiritual Care
